name: redis-agent-memory
description: Recall project context, record session events, and save agent handoff checkpoints in Redis Agent Memory.

base_url.title: Redis Agent Memory URL
base_url.description: HTTPS base URL for the Redis Agent Memory service.

api_key.title: Store API key
api_key.description: API key for the selected Redis Agent Memory store.

owner_id.title: Owner ID
owner_id.description: Optional stable owner shared across computers. Leave blank to derive a local owner.

namespace_id.title: Namespace resource ID
namespace_id.description: Optional Redis namespace resource ID. This takes precedence over the legacy namespace.

namespace.title: Legacy namespace
namespace.description: Project namespace used when no namespace resource ID is supplied.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Actor ID used for assistant events.

tools.name: memory_health
tools.description: Check whether the configured Redis Agent Memory store is ready.

tools.name: memory_append
tools.description: Append a user, assistant, or system event to ordered session memory.

tools.name: memory_get_session
tools.description: Retrieve ordered events and an optional session summary.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search owner- and namespace-scoped durable memories.

tools.name: checkpoint_save
tools.description: Create or update the durable checkpoint for a task session.

tools.name: resume_context
tools.description: Retrieve the checkpoint, session history, and related durable memories.
